hypothesis: PIT ownership disclosures and clustered insider filings create issuer-specific information-attention events whose confirmed or rejected opening response can persist beyond 09:35.

samples.oos: 2025-01-02 through 2026-09-16, closed unless one candidate passes every development and validation gate
samples.oos_disclosure: The dates are globally touched by other research families and cannot be marketed as pristine market-data OOS.

event_contract.source: Previously cached SEC submissions JSON for the PIT top500 issuer-CIK union
event_contract.session_assignment: First trading session whose 09:15 ET cutoff is strictly after acceptance, with an explicit prior-session lower bound.
event_contract.form4_cluster3: At least three exact Form 4 filings for one issuer CIK assigned to the same session; exclude Form 4/A. Direction is not inferred from transaction content.
event_contract.form4_cluster5: At least five exact Form 4 filings for one issuer CIK assigned to the same session; exclude Form 4/A. This is a pre-registered nested intensity threshold.
event_contract.ownership_active_initial: Exact SC 13D or SCHEDULE 13D; exclude all amendments.
event_contract.ownership_passive_initial: Exact SC 13G or SCHEDULE 13G; exclude all amendments.
event_contract.deduplication: One event per issuer CIK, assigned session, and class; earliest acceptance plus accession count is retained.
event_contract.issuer_representation: Highest-market-cap PIT top500 ticker per CIK at the latest quarterly snapshot on or before the event session.

signal_contract.universe: Quarterly Polygon PIT market-cap top500 plus current-day PIT price>=5 and lagged ADV20>=10m eligibility.
signal_contract.confirmed: Gap and first5_ret have the same non-zero sign; trade that sign.
signal_contract.rejected: Gap and first5_ret have opposite non-zero signs; trade the first5_ret sign.
signal_contract.exit: Exact 15:55 on the hold-th session, entry session counted as day 1.

portfolio_contract.overlap: No new position while issuer CIK is active.
portfolio_contract.capacity: Entry notional <=1% of current PIT ADV20.
portfolio_contract.missing_entry: Skip without replacement unless exact 09:35 exists.
portfolio_contract.missing_exit: Retain until next exact 09:35 or 15:55, whichever occurs first.

selection_rule.ranking: Highest base-4bps daily Sharpe among candidates passing all development gates.
selection_rule.tie_break: Higher stress8 Sharpe, then larger entry count, then shorter hold.
selection_rule.no_selection_result: KILL_BEFORE_OOS; do not modify forms, cluster thresholds, price filters, directions, holds, sizing, or gates.

audit_requirements: Report all candidates, both costs, yearly PnL, dollar and percentage DD, concentration, turnover, borrow, exposure, and long/short counts.
Treat Form 4 only as filing intensity; do not claim insider buying or selling without transaction-code parsing.
Separate rule-selection effect from causal trade-selection effect.
Archive all invalid runs and disclose corrections.
Do not use the old manual/restricted 62 universe or a learned ticker list.
